_comment: The 9am schedule. Copy to rotation.json and edit -- rotation.json is
gitignored so your targeting isn't committed.
Verticals are weighted by how many EL'd partners actually buy them:
landscaping (6), then fire & life safety and security integration.
MSP/IT is deliberately absent despite 5 partners wanting it. Managed
service providers rarely register with BBB -- it is a consumer-trust
directory and MSPs sell B2B -- so those lists would be mostly noise.
That vertical needs an Apollo-native search, not a BBB scrape.
`metros` is the cycle. Each run takes the next slug and remembers where
it stopped in .rotation-state.json, so Thursday never re-serves Monday's
companies. Replace these with the metros you actually sell into --
